name: 55974 · Spring Grove, MN
findings: ZIP 55974 (Spring Grove) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55974 (Spring Grove) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 55974 (Spring Grove) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).
